Do not confuse that notice with a court-issued subpoena. The supplied Manual practice describes a different procedure:
• Unless the court directs otherwise, the court registrar issues the subpoena under seal to the requesting party, for service on the person named.
• The person named is usually the Registrar of Trade Marks, although “the proper officer” of the Trade Marks Office is also acceptable.
• The subpoena must specify the documents required and the date and place for production (TMM/Part54/1/1/3).
